title: Competitive landscape: public positioning
subtitle: Seven plausible peers. Compare delivery models and proof, not unverified performance.
evidence: Bounded review of primary public service pages, homepage text and case pages.

positioningMap.label: Qualitative public-positioning map
positioningMap.evidence: Analyst placement from company and service messaging; not performance, AI visibility, traffic, rank or market share.

anchors.3: Dedicated ecommerce practice within a broad offer
anchors.5: Ecommerce or Shopify leads company identity

anchors.1: Sampled offer leads with traditional SEO
anchors.3: AI is included as a service component
anchors.5: AI search leads primary proposition or dedicated methodology

positioningMap.caution: Ordinal editorial placement; overlapping points are expected and do not rank agency quality.

competitors.name: SEOasis
competitors.positioning: Shopify-focused ecommerce SEO and AEO with direct access to senior operators.
competitors.contentFocus: Transactional collection clusters, a visible delivery cadence and quarterly learning.
competitors.caseStudyEvidence: Named Roofnest, TheFeed, Christy Dawn and TriRig examples on the homepage.
competitors.aeoPositioning: AI product recommendations lead the homepage proposition.
competitors.shopifySpecialization: Shopify is the explicit target platform.
competitors.authoritySignals: Named client examples, testimonials and named operating team; effectiveness is not independently verified.
competitors.differentiation: A focused combination of collection execution, Reddit presence and direct strategist communication.
competitors.evidence: Homepage names the audience, workstreams, collection cadence, reporting cadence and 90-day recalibration.

position.evidence: Company-level Shopify positioning and AI recommendations appear in the primary headline.

operatingImplication.summary: Use the interview artifact to demonstrate shipping, QA and learning inside this existing operating model.
operatingImplication.evidence: Proposed operator response to the observed public positioning; validate with SEOasis sales and client evidence.

competitors.evidence: The search page lists technical SEO, content, PR and analytics; the Shopify page includes SEO and paid-media execution.

operatingImplication.evidence: Proposed operator response to the observed public positioning; validate with SEOasis sales and client evidence.

synthesis.title: AI messaging is already shared across this comparison set
synthesis.summary: All seven peers have explicit AI-search or AEO messaging in the sampled public material. AEO terminology by itself should not be treated as an exclusive differentiator.
synthesis.evidence: Dedicated AI/AEO pages or AI sections were observed for all seven peers; this is a bounded sample, not a market census.

synthesis.title: Make the operating system tangible
synthesis.summary: SEOasis already communicates a collection-production cadence, direct strategist access and quarterly recalibration. The interview can demonstrate how a strategist would organize and QA those commitments.
synthesis.evidence: The SEOasis homepage states collection production, communication and 90-day planning practices.

synthesis.title: Collection expansion needs an account-level gate
synthesis.summary: SEOasis emphasizes new transactional collections while Searchbloom emphasizes consolidation for some catalogs. These are compatible account-specific choices: validate unique intent, assortment and URL overlap before deciding.
synthesis.evidence: The sampled methodologies emphasize different catalog conditions; no client catalog was available to select one action.

synthesis.title: Use case proof responsibly
synthesis.summary: Compare the specificity and availability of published cases, then ask for attribution definitions and time windows. Published agency outcomes do not support relative performance rankings.
synthesis.evidence: Peers publish named and anonymized cases across different channels, periods and attribution contexts.

limitations: Selected peers are plausible commercial alternatives because they publicly offer ecommerce or Shopify SEO; actual SEOasis sales competitors require CRM or founder validation.
This is a positioning comparison, not a verified search-rank, AI-output, pricing, market-share or performance comparison.
Axes are ordinal analyst interpretations of sampled public positioning. A one-step difference is not a measured advantage.
Case studies and client testimonials are company-published proof. No client analytics or attribution model was independently verified.
Eastside Co evidence came from publicly indexed primary-site text after direct fetch errors. Do not infer an outage or technical SEO issue from that tool limitation.
A service not found in the sample is not evidence that the agency does not provide it.
No paid keyword, traffic, backlink or AI-visibility dataset was used.

internalValidation.evidence: Public positioning cannot show which peers appear in SEOasis sales cycles or why buyers choose an agency.
